Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**DMA**

Solution
========
Direct Memory Access. The device reads and writes host memory on its own, without the CPU copying each byte. Its most important use is to move data between a device and memory while the CPU does something else, which is what makes high speed network and storage possible.
